reference_sql:
WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event with both IDs, 15 to 21 December 2025 (Dublin days): only the columns the rate needs
  SELECT traffic_source.medium AS medium,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS engaged
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251215' AND '20251221'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT medium, COUNT(*) AS sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE engaged = '1') AS engaged_sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE engaged = '1') / COUNT(*) AS engagement_rate
FROM starts
GROUP BY medium

WITH per_medium AS (
  -- one row per medium: its sessions and engaged sessions, 15 to 21 December 2025 (Dublin days)
  SELECT traffic_source.medium AS medium, COUNT(*) AS sessions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engaged_sessions
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251215' AND '20251221'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source.medium
)
SELECT medium, sessions, engaged_sessions, engaged_sessions / sessions AS engagement_rate
FROM per_medium

solver.query:
SELECT traffic_source.medium AS medium,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id || '-' || list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value) AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id || '-' || list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value) FILTER (WHERE list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value = '1') AS engaged_sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id || '-' || list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value) FILTER (WHERE list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value = '1') * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id || '-' || list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value) AS engagement_rate
FROM events
WHERE event_name = 'session_start' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251215' AND '20251221'
  AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY traffic_source.medium
